harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: The clause «تحرم», the answer to the vocative, is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «لِمَ» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تحرم»; the clause «تبتغي» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «تحرم»; the clause «والله غفور» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The clause «قد فرض» is resumptive; the clause «والله مولاكم» is resumptive; the clause «وهو العليم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «والله مولاكم». «تَحِلَّة» is the maṣdar (verbal noun) of «حلَّل», originally تَحْلِلَة, and it is accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The wāw is resumptive; «إذ» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the implied verb «اذكر» (remember); the clause «فلما نبأت به» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «أَسرَّ»; the clause «عرّف» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause «فلما نبأها» is conjoined to the clause «نبأت به»; the clause «أنبأك» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «مَنْ»; the clause «قال» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «هو» is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl). His words «وجبريل»: a mubtadaʾ (subject), what follows it is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to it, and «ظهير» is the khabar (predicate) of them all; «ظهير» is singular because it is on the pattern faʿīl; and «جبريل» is mentioned in the helping twice: once by being named explicitly, and once by being included in the generality of the angels.

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: «عسى» is incomplete (nāqiṣa), and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يبدله» is the khabar (predicate) of «عسى»; the clause «إن طلقكن» is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what precedes indicating it; «أزواجا» is a second object; «خيرا» and what follows it are naʿts (adjectives); the preposition and its genitive noun «منكنَّ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خيرا».

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: His words «قوا»: an imperative from الوقاية (protection), its pattern being عُوا; the fāʾ [of the root] was omitted because in the imperfect it occurs between a yāʾ and a kasra, and the imperative is modelled on it; the clause «وقودها الناس» is a naʿt (adjective) of «نارا», and the clause «عليها ملائكة» is a second naʿt; the clause «لا يَعْصُون» is a naʿt of «ملائكة»; «ما» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «ما أمرهم» is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from the Divine Name, i.e.: they do not disobey Allah's command.

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The clause «إنما تجزون» is resumptive; «ما» is a second object.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: «نصوحا» is an attribute of «توبة» by way of intensification, on the basis that it is the maṣdar (verbal noun) itself; the clause «عسى ربكم» is resumptive, and the maṣdar «أن يكفِّر» is the khabar (predicate) of «عسى»; the adverb «يوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يدخلكم»; the clause «نورهم يسعى» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «النبي والذين آمنوا معه»; the clause «يقولون» is a ḥāl from the pronoun in «أيديهم»; the clause «إنك على كل شيء قدير» is resumptive within the scope of the answer to the vocative.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The clause «ومأواهم جهنم» is resumptive, and the clause «وبئس المصير» is resumptive; the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e.: Jahannam.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: «امرأة» is a badal (substitute) from «مثلا»; the preposition and its genitive noun «للذين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «مثلا»; the clause «كانتا» is an explanation of «المثل»; the preposition and its genitive noun «من عبادنا» is attached to a naʿt of «عبدين»; the two preposition and its genitive nouns «عنهما من الله» are attached to the verb «يغنيا»; «شيئا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause «وقيل» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «يغنيا».

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: «امرأة» is a badal (substitute) from «مثلا»; «إذ» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ضرب»; the adverb «عندك» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «بيتا»; the preposition and its genitive noun «في الجنة» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «بيتا».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: His words «مريم»: a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «امرأة»; «ابنت» is a badal (substitute); «التي» is a naʿt (adjective) of «مريم».
